items.exampleEn: Reading in the bath is a simple but pleasurable habit.
items.exampleZh: 泡澡時看書是個簡單卻令人愉快的習慣。

items.exampleEn: Cats have an instinctive fear of deep water.
Nothing could disturb her tranquility, not even the crying baby next door.
items.exampleZh: 什麼都打擾不了她內心的平靜，連隔壁哭鬧的嬰兒也一樣。

items.exampleEn: As a child, she was quiet and compliant, always doing what she was told.
items.exampleZh: 她小時候安靜又順從，大人說什麼就做什麼。

items.exampleEn: Her bubbly laugh filled the whole room.
items.exampleZh: 她活潑開朗的笑聲充滿了整個房間。

items.exampleEn: "At least it can't get any worse," he said wryly.
items.exampleZh: 「至少不會再更糟了。」他自嘲地說。

items.exampleEn: There was something unsettling about the empty streets at night.
items.exampleZh: 夜裡空蕩蕩的街道，有種讓人不安的感覺。
items.glossZh: 令人不安的；使人心煩的

items.exampleEn: A scathing article in the paper blamed the city for its lack of parks.
items.exampleZh: 報上一篇措辭尖刻的文章，把市內公園太少歸咎於市政府。

items.sentenceEn: Her instinctive kindness made the new students feel welcome.
items.sentenceZh: 她發自本能的善意，讓新同學覺得受到歡迎。

items.audioEn: The critic wrote a scathing review, calling the new restaurant's food cold and its prices silly.
items.audioZh: 那位評論家寫了一篇尖刻的評論，說這家新餐廳的菜是冷的、價格荒謬。
items.questionZh: 評論家怎麼評價這家餐廳？
options: The review praised the friendly staff.
The review attacked both the food and the prices.
The review said it was worth a visit.
The review only talked about the music.

items.sentenceEn: My sister is so bubbly that she makes friends everywhere she goes.
items.sentenceZh: 我妹妹個性活潑開朗，走到哪裡都交得到朋友。

items.sentenceEn: The calm sea brought a feeling of tranquility to the whole beach.
items.sentenceZh: 平靜的海面為整片沙灘帶來一股寧靜。

items.stemEn: The long silence after his question was deeply ____.
items.stemZh: 他提問之後那段長長的沉默，讓人非常不安。

items.stemEn: He smiled ____ when his flight was delayed for the third time that week.
items.stemZh: 他的班機那週第三次延誤時，他苦笑了一下。

items.passageEn: When Joy, a bubbly young designer, joined a large advertising company, she found the office strangely quiet. Her manager expected staff to be compliant and never to question his ideas. At her first meeting, he gave a scathing review of a colleague's work in front of everyone, and the silence afterwards was unsettling. Joy's instinctive reaction was to speak up, but she decided to wait. Soon she felt apprehensive every Monday morning. Weekends became her escape: she hiked in the hills, where the tranquility helped her think clearly. After a year, she moved to a smaller firm. When old colleagues asked about her new job, she smiled wryly and said it was far more pleasurable than being afraid every day.
items.passageZh: 活潑開朗的年輕設計師 Joy 進入一家大型廣告公司時，發現辦公室安靜得出奇。她的經理要求員工服從，永遠不要質疑他的想法。在她參加的第一次會議上，經理當著大家的面把一位同事的作品批評得體無完膚，之後的沉默讓人很不安。Joy 本能的反應是想開口說話，但她決定先等等。很快地，她每個星期一早上都感到惶恐不安。週末成了她的避風港：她到山上健行，那裡的寧靜讓她能清楚思考。一年後，她轉到一家較小的公司。老同事問她新工作怎麼樣時，她苦笑著說，比每天提心吊膽愉快多了。

options: 每天提早一小時到公司上班
週末也要參加公司的活動
多提出自己的新點子和意見
當面向經理抗議他對同事太嚴厲
轉到一家規模較小的公司

items.promptZh: 老師對我的報告給了很嚴厲的批評。
referenceEn: My teacher was scathing about my report.
The teacher made some scathing comments on my report.
rubricZh: 「嚴厲批評的」用 scathing，可寫 be scathing about＋事物，或放名詞前（例如 scathing comments）
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 was、made）

items.promptZh: 那位廚師自嘲地說，他做的第一個蛋糕連他的狗都不吃。
referenceEn: The chef said wryly that even his dog would not eat his first cake.
The chef joked wryly that his first cake was so bad that even his dog refused it.
rubricZh: 「自嘲地」用 wryly（例如 said wryly、joked wryly 等）
時態配合內容（例如 said、would not eat 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
